label_policy.positive_definition: Dispatch an expert when the incident information available at supervisor time indicates that expert's domain is needed to investigate or contain the incident.
label_policy.none_definition: No expert in the current four-role taxonomy is justified by the supervisor-visible incident; this does not mean no SRE follow-up is needed.
label_policy.input_boundary: Labels use only each case's issue and evidence. They do not use agent_output, expected policy violations, guardrail findings, or simulated judge labels because those are not available to the supervisor in the implemented path.
label_policy.limitations: These are web-researched provisional judgments, not unique ground truth. SRE review is required before using them as a promotion gate.
